eligibility.evidence: Sec 3-4: about three dozen Transformer, LSTM and n-gram LMs trained from scratch by the authors per language; their surprisal is regressed on human eye-movement gaze duration (Dundee, BCCWJ-EyeTrack). No behavioural task is administered to a pretrained LLM; outcome is predictive power of model probabilities, not model behaviour.

A.title: Lower Perplexity is Not Always Human-Like
